overlapTerms: ## Conversational Texture The user wants the already completed Proof-or-stop branding visible remotely and has authorized integration. They expect the main baseline repairs to remain functional, the formal lifecycle to complete, and an actual remote result rather than another speculative completion claim.

## Key Insights A read-only merge-tree preview found eleven content conflicts, concentrated in version synchronization and overlapping validation evidence repairs. Remote history also includes lifecycle and runtime integrity improvements that must survive the integration unchanged where not conflicting.

## Solution Tradeoffs Use a normal merge in an isolated Story worktree, preserving both parent histories. Resolve only observed conflicts by comparing original intent and regression checks. Do not force-push, replace remote history, or expand into unrelated cleanup of existing runtime logs.
